title: Deep learning-driven imaging of cell division and cell growth across an entire eukaryotic life cycle
summary: Cellpose CNN segmentation and RIFE deep frame interpolation were used in the first preprint version; tracking was validated against manual annotations (n=680), and the paper reports cell growth and cell-cycle exit findings.
